body:
Measured in the 2026-09-20 steering benchmark (medians of 5 load-clean reps): pressing Escape stops visible output in 0 ms (the abort lands inside one 50 ms poll, fastest of the CLIs measured), but the process tree's CPU stays above 2% for ~7.0 s before the engine daemon winds down. Same harness: claude 1.2 s, omp 1.5 s.

The user-visible stop is instant; the resource stop is not. On battery and in CI that 7 s is real. Abort propagation from the TUI to the engine daemon (and whatever the engine keeps doing after the abort lands) needs a look.

—
